title: Russian — MVD Order No. 782 (2000), driving licences
authority: MVD Russia Order No. 782 of 2000 (instruction on driving licences), Appendix 5
description: Transliteration table of the MVD instruction on driving licences (Order No. 782 of 2000): Ё→YO/YE/E by context, Е→YE after vowels and Ъ/Ь, И→YI after Ь, Ъ and Ь → apostrophe.
notes: Rules follow iuliia.ru/mvd-782 and its JSON: Ъ/Ь are written as ' but dropped before Е, Ё and И (Васильева → Vasilyeva, Ильин → Ilyin).
Е at word start stays E (Erofeyev); Е after Й stays E (rule says 'after vowels and Ъ, Ь').
The rule text says Ё → YE 'after consonants'; this scheme counts Й as a consonant (iuliia's JSON does not list Й, giving YO there).
In iuliia's own examples Ё after consonants gives Artyem, Pyetr, Fyedor — this is what the instruction prescribes, although it differs from common usage (Artyom).

rules.note: Е → YE after vowels (after Ъ/Ь: see map ье/ъе)
Ё → YE after consonants except Ж Ч Ш Щ
Ё → E after Ж Ч Ш Щ; YO elsewhere (word-initial, after vowels, Ъ, Ь)

samples: Юлия, съешь ещё этих мягких французских булок из Йошкар-Олы, да выпей алтайского чаю
Yuliya, syesh' eshche etikh myagkikh frantsuzskikh bulok iz Yoshkar-Oly, da vypey altayskogo chayu
